news.headline: FDA approves Ilumya (tildrakizumab) for psoriatic arthritis
news.summary: Sun Pharma's IL-23 psoriasis biologic adds the joint indication (phase 3 INSPIRE-1/-2, >800 patients, ACR20 met at week 24) — the every-12-week shot her plaque-psoriasis patients already know now covers skin AND joints.
news.her_angle: 'psoriasis AND stiff, swollen fingers?' — joint pain isn't a separate problem; the same shot can now treat both — ask before joints are damaged
news.source: Dermatology Times (Oct 30) · Pharmaceutical Executive (Oct 30) · Sun Pharma release (Oct 30)
